title: Apigenin inhibits epithelial mesenchymal transition in renal tubular epithelial cells through PI3K/AKT and NF-kappaB pathways for treating renal fibrosis.
authors: Sun, Tao; Wang, Baoying; Wang, Zhan; Chen, Lei; Li, Zhenzhen; Li, Ningning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芹菜素通过PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB通路抑制肾小管上皮细胞上皮间质转化治疗肾纤维化，仅涉及分子对接和网络药理学，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Renal fibrosis is a crucial factor in the progression of chronic kidney diseases. Previous studies have suggested that apigenin (API) has potential in ameliorating renal fibrosis, but its therapeutic mechanism remains unclear. This study aims to elucidate the mechanisms by which API treats renal fibrosis using network pharmacology and experimental validation. Initially, we used the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) Database and GeneCards database to identify molecular targets of API and associated genes. Next, we constructed a network of API-renal fibrosis targets, followed by protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis. Subsequent analyses, such as Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment, were performed using the Database for Annotation, Visualization, and Integrated Discovery (DAVID). We also performed molecular docking studies to explore API's interactions with key proteins. To validate API's mechanism in treating renal fibrosis, we used a Human Kidney-2 (HK-2) cell model of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) induced by transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1). We identified 77 API target genes, 8434 renal fibrosis target genes, and 64 intersection genes, which were primarily enriched in nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) and Phosphatidylinositide 3-kinases/protein kinase B (PI3K-AKT) pathways. API significantly inhibited EMT in TGF-beta1-induced HK-2 cells by regulating the expression of alpha-Smooth muscle actin (alpha-SMA) and E-cadherin and suppressing the protein expression of p-PI3K, p-AKT, and p-P65, which are related to the PI3K-AKT and NF-kappaB pathways. However, co-administration of the PI3K agonist 740Y-P counteracted API's inhibitory effects on these protein expressions. In summary, these findings highlight API's therapeutic potential in treating renal fibrosis by modulating EMT in renal tubular epithelial cells via the PI3K-AKT and NF-kappaB pathways.
abstract_zh: 肾纤维化是慢性肾脏疾病进展中的关键因素。既往研究表明，芹菜素（API）在改善肾纤维化方面具有潜力，但其治疗机制尚不明确。本研究旨在通过网络药理学和实验验证阐明API治疗肾纤维化的机制。首先，我们使用中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）和GeneCards数据库识别API的分子靶点及相关基因。接着，我们构建了API-肾纤维化靶点网络，随后进行蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）分析。后续分析，如基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集，使用注释、可视化和集成发现数据库（DAVID）进行。我们还进行了分子对接研究，以探索API与关键蛋白的相互作用。为验证API治疗肾纤维化的机制，我们使用了转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）诱导的上皮-间质转化（EMT）人肾-2（HK-2）细胞模型。我们识别出77个API靶基因、8434个肾纤维化靶基因和64个交集基因，这些基因主要富集于核因子κB（NF-κB）和磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K-AKT）通路。API通过调节α-平滑肌肌动蛋白（α-SMA）和E-钙黏蛋白的表达，并抑制与PI3K-AKT和NF-κB通路相关的p-PI3K、p-AKT和p-P65蛋白表达，显著抑制TGF-β1诱导的HK-2细胞EMT。然而，PI3K激动剂740Y-P的联合给药抵消了API对这些蛋白表达的抑制作用。总之，这些发现强调了API通过PI3K-AKT和NF-κB通路调节肾小管上皮细胞EMT，从而在治疗肾纤维化中的治疗潜力。
